raw_segments.text: To the hill then, I turned. I reached it. It remained now only to find a hollow where
I could lie down and feel at least hidden if not secure. But all the surface of the
waist looked level. It showed no variation but of tint—green, where Rush and Moss overgrew
the marshes, black, where the dry soil bore only heath. Dark as it was getting, I could
still see these changes, though but as mere alternations of light and shade, for color
